text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 255:383 (approximately 0.666:1), target canvas 510 × 766 pixels.

Create one independent photorealistic studio portrait on a completely seamless pure white #FFFFFF background. Bright soft frontal light, balanced fill, low contrast, faint optical halation, natural pores and fine facial hair, detailed real cotton and knit fabric, realistic 50mm perspective, both eyes sharp and background clean. No room, scenery, props, gradient, vignette, frame, collage, text, branding or watermark. Keep the entire hairstyle inside the frame with a small white margin. Single chest-up to mid-torso portrait of a 17-year-old Latina girl with warm light-olive skin, long chestnut waves, hazel-brown eyes, softly defined cheekbones, small straight nose and full natural pink lips; light blue denim jacket over ivory tee, lightly tilted head and friendly restrained smile. Shoulders visible, subject fills most of the frame, body slightly angled, eyes toward camera unless a sideways gaze is specified. Soft warm-neutral skin, teen subjects retain youthful proportions and light natural makeup.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。

original_prompt:
Create a clean 2x2 preview sheet with four separate original fictional character portraits, all waist-up and centered on a seamless pure white #FFFFFF studio background. No room, classroom, window, architecture, scenery, props, furniture, colored backdrop, gradient, border, labels, logo or watermark. Use bright high-key exposure, soft frontal light, low shadows, natural skin microtexture, realistic fine hair, restrained makeup, subtle halation and realistic 50mm portrait rendering. Do not copy any attached person's face, likeness, exact outfit, pose, background or pixels; references are mood and styling only. No dark teal/green grade, heavy makeup, plastic skin, HDR, illustration or 3D render.

Panel 1: 17-year-old Latina girl, soft chestnut waves, light denim jacket over ivory tee, lively natural expression.
Panel 2: 18-year-old pale blonde girl, straight center-parted hair, cream cable-knit sweater and muted blue ribbon, reserved expression.
Panel 3: 17-year-old Middle Eastern girl, shoulder-length dark bob, pale gray blazer and white shirt, composed intelligent expression.
Panel 4: June, the only adult, age 23, warm brunette hair in a loose low ponytail, cream blouse and camel coat, understated mature expression. Make her clearly older than the other three. Keep all faces distinct and newly invented.
